title: [Godot 4.6] Editor ignores position changes for Inherited UI elements if its position in current scene is same as the original value
body: ### Tested versions Godot 4.6 Stable Mono ### System information Godot v4.6.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7688) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.10 GiB memory ### Issue description For inherited UI elements, if those elements are originally the root in their own scene, and they have their own position (Let's say x=8, y=512). Then when they are added as a child in a new scene and set with the same (relative) position in this scene (x=8, y=512), the editor will not register the position properly and falls back to 0. This works independent of x and y changes. The editor will still show the "intended" position, however it is never registered and fails to show up on run scene or when project reloads. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Scene called `TestChildColorRect` in its own scene, with relative position at 8,512 2. 2 instances of `TestChildColorRect` are added into `Computer`, the top one set its position at 8,368, and the bottom one set its position at 9,512 3. On scene runs, the top colorrect stop respecting the x position, the bottom colorrect stop respecting the y position: (Same thing happening with button 1 and 2 which has similar structure) 4. If project is reloaded, all the editor changes use the underlaying tscn values and therefore moves the UIs components to the same location shown on scene run ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Repo: https://github.com/Xascoria/BugReproduceLayout The repo will show different layout than the last thing I saved as changes are not being picked up by the editor, which is as follows:
